instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Real estate brokerage with 8 offices and 85 agents facilitating residential and light commercial transactions. Average of 600 closed transactions annually. Evaluating AI-powered property valuation models and automated comparable market analysis report generation. We are a bootstrapped company with a lean team. Every euro of investment must show near-immediate ROI given our constrained working capital. The founder is involved in all strategic decisions including innovation priorities.
answers.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources. Our current portfolio includes 4 active projects across new business models, digital products, and operational AI use cases. One incubated project has already graduated to become a standalone business unit.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

input.changes_since_last: Acquired 8 new enterprise clients. Expanded into adjacent market. Digital maturity improving.

opportunities.title: Specialized AI Consulting for Adjacent Assets
opportunities.rationale: The company needs to escape structural decline by productizing its newfound expertise in valuation and market analysis. Instead of selling real estate transactions, they should offer their proprietary AI models as a service (AIaaS) to other distressed or specialized commercial/industrial property sectors. This provides immediate diversification and leverages the core technological asset.

first_actions: Identify 2 non-real estate adjacent markets with distress signals (e.g., warehouse retrofitting, specialized medical facilities).
Develop a minimum viable offering (MVO) that packages existing AI valuation models into a high-level consulting report format.
Pilot the MVO using one of the new enterprise clients as a controlled test case.
resources_needed: Business Development Lead (Focus on Consulting Sales)
execution_plan.success_metric: Securing 2 paid consulting pilot projects outside the core residential market within 6 months.
milestones: MVO definition and pricing model established (Month 1).
Pilot execution with first external client (Month 3).

opportunities.title: Vertical Integration with Key Enterprise Clients
opportunities.rationale: The acquisition of 8 enterprise clients represents a significant resource advantage. Instead of treating them as individual leads, the firm should systematize services that deepen relationships (e.g., project management, due diligence reporting). This converts transactional revenue into sticky, recurring service contracts.

first_actions: Develop a tiered service model based on client size/complexity (Silver, Gold, Platinum).
Assign internal resources to map the operational needs of the top 3 largest new clients against existing service gaps.
Formalize quarterly business review meetings with these key accounts to present upsell opportunities.
execution_plan.success_metric: Converting 20% of the new enterprise client base into recurring monthly service revenue within 6 months.
milestones: Service tier model finalized and approved (Month 1).
Initial pitch delivered to key accounts (Month 3).
First retainer contract signed under the expanded model (Month 6).

next_steps.action: Create a dedicated Innovation Program Manager role (Part-time contractor initially) to shield the developers from operational distractions and formalize cross-functional task ownership.
Conduct a structured 'Value Chain Mapping' workshop focusing on the 8 new enterprise clients to identify non-real estate dependencies and pain points that AI/consulting can solve.
Formalize the internal venture studio investment criteria to prioritize projects that involve external partnerships or data monetization potential, rather than just internal efficiency gains.

key_weaknesses: Critical Talent Bottleneck: Innovation capacity is too dependent on the limited bandwidth of 2 generalist developers, creating a severe time risk.
Scaling Operational Reliance: The model still heavily relies on the founder's involvement in strategic decision-making and new revenue origination.
Internal Process vs. External Sales Focus: While internal processes (venture studio) are formalized, translating these into scalable external consulting services remains underdeveloped.

improvements: Strong process maturity demonstrated by the successful formalization of the venture studio model and graduating a business unit.
Significant revenue pipeline expansion via 8 new enterprise clients.
Increased budgetary commitment (9% allocation) signals organizational buy-in for growth.
persistent_gaps: The core barrier of dedicated R&D talent and time has not been resolved by the current team structure.
Moving from transactional real estate services to specialized, scalable consulting is a conceptual leap that requires external sales process development.
achieved_milestones: Operationalization of the internal venture studio model.
Establishment of market diversification through new enterprise acquisition/expansion.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has significantly matured its internal process (formal venture studio) and successfully expanded its client base into adjacent markets, validating the diversification strategy. However, critical resource constraints persist.
